project_type: Vite React SPA with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Recharts
test_framework: Playwright for E2E tests (no unit test framework currently)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` - must succeed with 0 TypeScript errors. 2. Optionally run `npm run lint`. 3. Manual verification: Start dev server with `npm run dev`, fill in property data, confirm prediction panel uses consistent data.
environment_constraints: React 19, no unit tests currently, only E2E via Playwright.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns, TypeScript strict mode, maintain Japanese-style comments in files.
key_patterns: 1. State lifted to App.tsx, passed down as props. 2. Hooks (useMarketData, usePrediction) encapsulate data fetching and calculation logic. 3. Types in src/types/index.ts and src/types/prediction.ts. 4. Calculation logic in src/utils/calculator.ts (analysis) and src/utils/predictor.ts (prediction). 5. Components receive data via props and call onChange callbacks.
directory_structure: src/components/ (UI), src/hooks/ (custom hooks), src/utils/ (calculation logic), src/types/ (TypeScript types), src/data/ (static economic data)
